sources.detail: Cloudflare blocks every non-interactive client with HTTP 403, a headless browser and a browser's user agent included (checked 2026-10-08). Only the club allowing the job's user agent would change that; its acts often play Comedy Club KC and recordBar, which are sources.

sources.detail: A winery's own programming, nearly all of it promotions in the rules' sense (weekly live music at the vineyard, Sip & Shop markets, make-and-take workshops, Breakfast with The Mean One, Boozy Book Exchange). Its events were shown before and had the same problem. Excluded 2026-11-03, Evan's call, so discovery stops suggesting it (16 runs, 25 held events on 11-02) and skips its leads.
